name: Translate to French
description: A voice speaks what you say in French. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 129 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to French model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0. Voice: Piper voice fr_FR-siwis-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, CC BY 4.0.
